sections.text_helper: Section 6.10.4 "FLASH operation status register (FLASH_OPSR)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 176.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x018
Reset value: 0xXXXX XXXX
This register can be protected against unprivileged access when PRIV = 1
inFLASH_PRIVCFGR.
Bits 31:29 CODE_OP[2:0]: Flash memory operation code
000: No FLASH operation ongoing during previous reset
001: Single write operation interrupted
010: Reserved
011: Page erase operation interrupted
100: Bank erase operation interrupted
101: Mass erase operation interrupted
110: Option change operation interrupted
111: Reserved
Bits 28:25 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 24 OTP_OP: OTP operation interrupted
This bit indicates that a reset interrupted an ongoing operation in the OTP area.
Bit 23 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 22 BK_OP: Interrupted operation bank
This bit indicates which bank was concerned by operation. (Refer to SectionTable 24.:
Memory map and the swapping option (STM32C53x/542 devices))
Bit 21 DATA_OP: FLASH data area operation interrupted
This bit indicates if user data FLASH area is concerned by an operation.
Bits 20:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:0 ADDR_OP[15:0]: Interrupted operation address
